item.title: Syria-Jordan border crossing closed following Jordanian strike in Syria
item.description:
Syria's Border Crossings and Customs Authority announced the closure of the Nasib border crossing with Jordan following a Jordanian strike in southern Syria.
The authority said that passenger and cargo traffic through the crossing had been suspended in both directions.

item.title: Trump on Iran war: We had no choice, we didn’t start the war
item.description: Trump defends the war against Iran, warning that Tehran's missiles could threaten US cities: It should’ve been done a long time ago.

item.description: Israeli actress Gal Gadot receives an honorary doctorate from Bar-Ilan University, reflecting on October 7, Jewish unity and mutual responsibility while urging Israelis to vote.

item.description: President Trump denies reports that Netanyahu sought another endorsement ahead of Israel's election, while praising the Prime Minister's leadership and their joint actions against Iran.

item.description: In a special lecture ahead of the elections, Rabbi Dudi Dudkevitch emphasized that voting is not merely a civic right, but a Torah obligation and a responsibility toward the future of the country.

item.title: Jordan launches airstrikes in Syria in retaliation for deadly church attack
item.description: Jordanian fighter jets strike terrorist hideouts in southern Syria after a deadly church funeral shooting killed nine people and wounded 34.

item.title: Trump praises Netanyahu on eve of election: "He did a very good job"
item.description: United States President Donald Trump praised Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in a conversation with reporters, saying: "Netanyahu has done a very good job as prime minister, under extremely challenging conditions."

item.title: 7.3 Million eligible voters: Your complete guide to Israel's elections
item.description: Ahead of Israel's Knesset elections, find out where and when to vote, what identification to bring, which rides are free, and when results are expected.

item.title: The antisemitic pro-Abdul El-Sayed ad sparking controversy
item.description: A campaign ad from Cenk Uygur's PAC backing Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed sparked antisemitism accusations after blaming US grocery prices on aid to Israel.

item.title: Following campaign video, Agam Berger slams Yair Golan
item.description: Captivity survivor Agam Berger criticized a campaign video released by Yair Golan's Democrats Party that combined footage of the October 7 attacks with political messages.

item.title: IDF eliminates four Hamas and Islamic Jihad terrorists in Gaza
item.description: The IDF eliminated four Hamas and Islamic Jihad terrorists in strikes across the Gaza Strip over the weekend, including a Hamas Nukhba cell commander and a sniper who targeted Israeli troops.

item.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan hold high-level talks with Iran
item.description: Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani officials meet Iranian leaders in Tehran to discuss de-escalation as Houthi attacks continue and Egypt backs Saudi defense.

item.title: Mr. President, Iran Is not Venezuela: Think twice!
item.description: if you insist on applying the Venezuelan model to Iran, Mr. President, history may remember you not for completing the struggle against Islamic terrorism, but for leaving that struggle unfinished. Opinion.

item.title: Report: Hezbollah rebuilding military capabilities with Iranian funding
item.description: Reuters reports that Hezbollah has received tens of millions of dollars from Iran to replenish its arsenal, develop explosive drones, and prepare for a possible renewal of fighting with Israel.

item.title: Eretz Yisrael is real
item.description: The next time you are offered the opportunity to join a new Jewish community in America with glatt kosher restaurants and bakeries, magnificent shuls, luxurious mikvahs, affordable villas, and all the comforts of your dreams, think twice.

item.title: Report in Russia: Putin to meet with Iranian president and Qatari emir tomorrow
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin is expected to meet with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian in Moscow tomorrow. The two are also expected to meet with the Emir of Qatar later.

item.title: "I thought we were on commercialS": Actress caught off guard during live broadcast
item.description: Chelli Goldenberg made harsh remarks about "the occupation and the settlers," only to discover that the conversation had been broadcast live. "I thought we were on a commercial break," she said.

item.title: Footage from Khan Yunis: IDF strikes terrorists emerging from tunnel
item.description: After IDF troops identified three terrorists exiting a tunnel shaft in Khan Yunis, an aircraft struck the shaft and the terrorists.

item.title: Saudi Arabia: Three drones intercepted in the Riyadh area and the south of the kingdom
item.description: Saudi military spokesman Turki al-Maliki announced that the Saudi military intercepted three unmanned aerial vehicles in the area of ​​the capital Riyadh and in the south of the kingdom.

item.title: 'A step away from disaster': Yitzhar residents demand IDF action after rock attack
item.description: Following a rock attack on families traveling home, Yitzhar residents demand the IDF clear buildings and groves near the road to prevent further attacks.

item.title: Report: Hezbollah preparing for a regional war
item.description:
Hezbollah has been preparing for the renewal of Israeli attacks over the past three months, while at the same time receiving tens of millions of dollars from Iran to restore its military capabilities, according to a report by the Reuters news agency.
Sources in Lebanon said that the organization is also working to rehabilitate its top leadership. Earlier this month, Reuters reported that Iran had transferred about $200 million to Hezbollah for military rehabilitation purposes.

item.title: 17-year-old girl hospitalized in serious condition due to flu complications
item.description: A teenage girl with no underlying medical conditions is hospitalized in intensive care at Assuta Ashdod Hospital following a severe complication of influenza. Her condition deteriorated within hours, and she is now sedated and on a ventilator.
